workflows.title: Sign in and choose a branch

steps.title: School sign-in
steps.help: Use the school’s published entry. Its branding does not grant access.

steps.title: Choose your workspace
steps.help: Only authorized branches appear. Skip this step when there is only one.

workflows.outcome: The administrator lands on Today in the chosen branch.
workflows.rule: Recheck institution, branch, membership and module state; return URLs must be allowlisted.
workflows.edge: Invalid credentials use a generic message; suspended access shows a support route, never another branch’s data.
workflows.data: UserAccount → SchoolMembership → RoleGrant → Organization / School. Read only; session issuance is owned by Access.

workflows.title: Activate or recover an account

steps.title: Request access help
steps.help: The available recovery path follows the institution and account-wide trust policy.

steps.title: Next steps
steps.help: The public response must not reveal account existence or which institution restricts recovery.

fields.name: ack
fields.label: I understand that the verified recovery channel must be used.

workflows.outcome: A generic acknowledgement and permitted recovery instructions are shown.
workflows.rule: Email resets must satisfy every active institution membership at issue and consume time; operator recovery remains supported.
workflows.edge: Expired, revoked, failed-delivery and previously consumed tokens cannot be accepted; resend rotates the token.
workflows.data: Access owns invitation/activation/reset tokens, consumption transaction, audit and delivery outcome. Never put secrets in audit.

workflows.title: Switch branch or sign out

steps.title: Destination
steps.help: Your current branch remains active until you confirm.

steps.title: Leave this workspace
steps.help: Unsaved changes must be saved or explicitly discarded before continuing.

fields.name: leave
fields.label: I have reviewed any unsaved work.

workflows.outcome: New context is resolved on the server, or the session is signed out.
workflows.rule: Clear scoped caches and protected drafts; reauthorize the destination and never reuse the previous branch’s data.
workflows.edge: If the target grant was revoked, keep the old context if still authorized and show a safe explanation.
workflows.data: Access session/context read; revoke session on sign-out. No business table writes.

workflows.title: Complete first-use setup

steps.title: Review readiness
steps.help: Only prerequisites for your enabled modules belong in this checklist.

steps.title: Assign the next action
steps.help: The checklist reflects saved records, not a manually checked completion flag.

workflows.outcome: The next incomplete dependency opens in its owning module.
workflows.rule: Setup completion is derived from authoritative data; adding Fees later must not invalidate Attendance readiness.
workflows.edge: Show blocked dependencies with a route to the responsible role; a hidden module is never a missing step.
workflows.data: Read model joins authorized School configuration, academic readiness, membership, enrollment and session counts.

workflows.title: Resolve a daily exception

steps.title: Choose an issue
steps.help: Each item links to evidence and the action that resolves it.

steps.title: Review ownership
steps.help: An exception does not disappear until its underlying record changes.

workflows.outcome: The source record opens with its branch and status intact.
workflows.rule: Never turn a pending register into an absence; the dashboard is a read model.
workflows.edge: An already resolved or revoked item refreshes safely and explains why it is no longer actionable.
workflows.data: Read AttendanceSession, ImportJob and permitted access status; no separate shadow business state.

workflows.title: Edit branch information

steps.title: School information
steps.help: Maintain operational contact details for this branch.

steps.title: Review changes
steps.help: The institution identity, branch code and existing time zone are controlled separately.

workflows.outcome: Permitted details are saved with a revision and activity entry.
workflows.rule: Time zone Asia/Kolkata is read-only after branch creation. Reject a forged change server-side.
workflows.edge: A stale edit shows the latest saved values and a comparison; never overwrite automatically.
workflows.data: Access owns School changes; Branding/contact read models read the saved revision. Compare expected version under the guard.

workflows.title: Review branding and school sign-in

steps.title: Preview school identity
steps.help: Use constrained tokens so accessibility and layout remain consistent.

fields.name: welcome
fields.label: Welcome message
fields.value: A clear start to every school day.

steps.title: Review before publication
steps.help: Preview desktop and mobile. Publication requires the institution’s branding permission.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed the school name, sign-in URL and palette.

workflows.outcome: A delegated publisher can publish; other school administrators can request a branding update.
workflows.rule: Branding never changes authorization, status semantics, layout or external redirect destinations.
workflows.edge: Reject unsafe assets, unreadable colors and an already claimed public slug; keep the published revision unchanged.
workflows.data: BrandProfile / revision owned by Branding, linked to Organization and authorized School. Public projection contains no private settings.

workflows.title: Review modules and request a capability
workflows.capability: module status read; commercial changes are institution/operator authority

steps.title: Choose a module
steps.help: See enabled modules and dependencies without exposing unlicensed operational screens.

steps.title: Request a change
steps.help: Commercial and branch activation approvals stay with the authorized owner.

workflows.outcome: The administrator gets a clear handoff to the institution contact.
workflows.rule: Licensed, released, branch-enabled and authorized are four separate checks. No self-service license escalation.
workflows.edge: Disabling a module retains data and must respect open obligations; request submission alone changes nothing.
workflows.data: Tenancy read model for entitlement and branch activation. Proposed change request only if an approved request contract exists; otherwise display contact instructions.

workflows.title: Create an academic year and calendar

steps.title: Academic year
steps.help: Use the school’s civil dates.

steps.title: Teaching days
steps.help: Calendar changes create a reviewed revision.

steps.title: Review impact
steps.help: Check date bounds and existing scheduled sessions before saving.

workflows.outcome: A valid year and immutable calendar revision are available.
workflows.rule: Reject invalid/reversed ranges and incompatible scheduled dates; existing sessions keep their pinned calendar revision.
workflows.edge: A concurrent calendar update requires reload and impact review.
workflows.data: Academics owns AcademicYear and CalendarRevision; sessions reference the selected calendar version.

workflows.title: Configure grades, sections and subjects

steps.title: Class structure
steps.help: Codes are unique within the documented branch/year scope.

steps.title: Review dependencies
steps.help: Referenced records can be retired prospectively, never deleted from history.

workflows.outcome: The class and subject are available for offering setup.
workflows.rule: Do not silently merge duplicate names; enforce scoped code constraints.
workflows.edge: An in-use record shows dependency counts and a supported retirement path.
workflows.data: Academics owns Grade, Section and Subject; enrollment placements and offerings reference their identities.

workflows.title: Create an offering and assign a teacher

steps.title: Teaching context
steps.help: An offering connects class, subject and academic year.

steps.title: Teacher and dates
steps.help: Only verified, eligible teachers appear.

steps.title: Review assignment
steps.help: Check teacher eligibility and schedule clashes.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: I have reviewed the assignment period.

workflows.outcome: A dated teaching assignment is saved.
workflows.rule: Identity binding and teacher eligibility are separate from account activation; enforce non-overlap under the documented guard.
workflows.edge: A teacher becoming ineligible before save rejects the command and retains safe form input.
workflows.data: Academics owns Offering and Assignment; published People/Access contracts verify Employee, Person binding and membership.

workflows.title: Change calendar or teaching assignment

steps.title: Choose the change
steps.help: Show the effective date and affected future sessions.

steps.title: Review affected sessions
steps.help: Open and submitted sessions cannot be silently rewritten.

workflows.outcome: A supported future-dated change preserves historical references.
workflows.rule: Block changes affecting frozen/submitted roster history in the first release; substitutions are a later explicit workflow.
workflows.edge: List conflicting sessions and let the administrator resolve them before retrying.
workflows.data: Owner use case reads dependent AttendanceSession references; new academic revision/dates plus transactional audit.

workflows.title: Create a staff profile

steps.title: Staff details
steps.help: A staff record can exist without a login.

steps.title: Employment
steps.help: Choose a role label and effective employment dates.

workflows.outcome: An organization Person and branch Employee profile are linked deliberately.
workflows.rule: Email/name matches are not proof of identity or authority to merge people.
workflows.edge: Exact identity candidates need an explicit review; duplicate employee codes are rejected.
workflows.data: People owns Person and Employee with scoped uniqueness and explicit links. No account is automatically created.

workflows.title: Grant staff sign-in access

steps.title: Select staff
steps.help: Access is a separate operation from creating an employee.

steps.title: Verify and scope
steps.help: A non-sensitive reference records the out-of-band verification.

steps.title: Issue access
steps.help: The trust mode selects the allowed invitation path.

fields.name: grant
fields.label: I confirm the verified identity and selected branch role.

workflows.outcome: A pending membership/grant is created and the permitted activation path is shown.
workflows.rule: Preserve operator-issued IAM paths; invite email does not prove employee identity. Last-admin safeguards remain.
workflows.edge: A failed delivery is visible to the authorized manager; resend revokes the old token.
workflows.data: Access owns UserAccount, SchoolMembership, RoleGrant and Invite/AccountActivation; People binding is checked through its published contract.

workflows.title: Review invitation or resend access

steps.title: Review access state
steps.help: Separate membership state from delivery and activation.

steps.title: Retry safely
steps.help: Revoke the previous invitation before issuing a replacement.

workflows.outcome: The new invitation attempt has an expiry and an honest delivery outcome.
workflows.rule: Do not activate on send, silently retry in a worker, expose tokens or reuse a failed token.
workflows.edge: Policy tightened, account blocked or expired grant explains why resend is unavailable.
workflows.data: Access token revoke + fresh issue + audit commit before email seam; sanitized delivery failure recorded afterward.

workflows.title: Verify a staff identity and teacher eligibility

steps.title: Identity evidence
steps.help: Record a non-sensitive reference to the school’s verification process.

steps.title: Teacher eligibility
steps.help: A teaching profile needs an active eligible employee and permitted account binding.

fields.name: verified
fields.label: The school has verified this identity outside email activation.

workflows.outcome: The teacher can be selected for dated assignments when all requirements are met.
workflows.rule: No auto-binding by email equality; explicit IAM-03 acceptance gates in the actual repository must be preserved.
workflows.edge: Changing eligibility lists affected assignments; a conflicting effective date is blocked.
workflows.data: People/Access own verified binding; Academics owns Teacher eligibility. Mutations use published contracts, not foreign table writes.

workflows.title: Change or revoke staff access

steps.title: Select the access change
steps.help: Only this branch’s grant changes.

steps.title: Review impact
steps.help: Assignments, sessions and the last active administrator require review.

fields.name: confirm
fields.label: I have reviewed affected work and access.

workflows.outcome: The next protected request rechecks the changed grant.
workflows.rule: Do not disable a global identity for a local branch action; prevent removal of the last active administrator.
workflows.edge: Concurrent revocations serialize; insufficient replacement/admin coverage blocks the action.
workflows.data: Access membership/grant transaction and audit; related assignment reads show impact without rewriting history.

workflows.title: Register a student manually

steps.title: Identity
steps.help: Create a person or explicitly select an exact existing identity.

steps.title: School record
steps.help: Admission number stays stable in this branch.

steps.title: Review identity
steps.help: Review a single exact candidate; do not match by email, name similarity or ranked results.

fields.name: identity
fields.label: I have verified that this is the intended student.

workflows.outcome: A Student profile references the deliberately selected organization Person.
workflows.rule: Same-institution identity lookup is exact admission number or person ID only; no broad person discovery.
workflows.edge: Duplicate/racing admission numbers show the existing permitted record or a conflict; no automatic merge.
workflows.data: People Person and Students Student are created through the owner contracts in the documented transaction.

workflows.title: Enroll and place a student

steps.title: Enrollment
steps.help: Choose the student and year.

steps.title: Class placement
steps.help: Dates determine which class roster the pupil belongs to.

steps.title: Review placement
steps.help: Check overlapping placements and any frozen attendance sessions.

workflows.outcome: The enrollment and effective placement are saved.
workflows.rule: One enrollment per student/year and non-overlapping placement intervals; no rewriting frozen rosters.
workflows.edge: A conflicting placement or open session is shown with a recovery link.
workflows.data: Students owns Enrollment and SectionPlacement; authorized academics references and attendance impact query are checked.

workflows.title: Review or update a student record

steps.title: Student record
steps.help: The student detail page groups identity, enrollment and permitted module panels.

steps.title: Review correction
steps.help: Identity corrections preserve a change history.

workflows.outcome: The permitted correction is saved with a reason and revision.
workflows.rule: Student 360 panels are separately entitled and authorized; a student view is not authority to edit Fees or Health.
workflows.edge: Concurrent edits show a comparison; a restricted panel is omitted rather than partially leaking its data.
workflows.data: People owns name facts, Students owns school identity/enrollment; compose reads through approved scoped joins.

workflows.title: Move a student to another section

steps.title: New placement
steps.help: This is a dated move within the same branch.

steps.title: Review roster changes
steps.help: The current placement closes at the new placement boundary.

fields.name: impact
fields.label: No frozen or submitted session is being rewritten.

workflows.outcome: Current and new placement intervals remain contiguous and explainable.
workflows.rule: Reject unsupported backdated changes; already frozen/submitted rosters remain unchanged.
workflows.edge: Offer a future valid date when historical attendance conflicts; do not delete and recreate enrollment.
workflows.data: Students closes old SectionPlacement and appends new placement atomically after Attendance impact checks.

workflows.title: Promote, transfer or leave school

steps.title: Lifecycle action
steps.help: Keep prior enrollment and attendance history intact.

steps.title: Destination and obligations
steps.help: Destination access and open obligations are reviewed independently.

steps.title: Confirm lifecycle change
steps.help: A cross-branch move creates a destination profile under that branch’s authority.

workflows.outcome: A dated lifecycle case records the outcome and preserves source history.
workflows.rule: Bulk promotion requires preview and per-student results; financial balances do not transfer by moving a student row.
workflows.edge: Partial results, destination rejection, changed capacity and duplicate confirmation require recoverable receipts.
workflows.data: Students owns LifecycleCase and enrollment changes; Finance/Documents/Guardians use explicit follow-up contracts.

workflows.title: Preview a roster import

steps.title: Target and template
steps.help: Context is supplied separately from STUDENT_ROSTER_V1 rows.

steps.title: Choose file
steps.help: UTF-8 CSV; production limits and per-request chunk bounds follow the Imports LLD.

steps.title: Review preview
steps.help: Inspect creates, no-change rows, conflicts and errors before confirming.

fields.name: preview
fields.label: I have reviewed the synthetic preview: 3 creates, 1 unchanged, 1 error.

workflows.outcome: A preview is available; no student records are written.
workflows.rule: No guardian columns in the Phase 1 roster contract; no raw rows, file bytes or hashes in audit.
workflows.edge: Invalid encoding/header/size fails clearly; schema error gives the correct template; no silent truncation.
workflows.data: Imports owns immutable source hash in ImportJob, versioned preview and bounded rows. Preview reads authorized academic/student facts only.

workflows.title: Confirm, resume and reconcile an import

steps.title: Confirm preview
steps.help: Confirmation pins source hash, context, preview revision and referenced versions.

steps.title: Review partial results
steps.help: Successful rows stay committed; failed rows keep their row number and reason.

workflows.outcome: Each row reports created, unchanged, failed or remaining with durable receipts.
workflows.rule: Create-only plus exact no-change re-import in Phase 1; corrections and transfers use explicit workflows.
workflows.edge: Stale previews require re-preview; lost responses query receipts before retry; avoid replaying successes.
workflows.data: Per-row transaction: Person, Student, Enrollment/Placement, external mapping, row receipt, audit and outbox. Bounded batch processing, no assumed worker.

workflows.title: Schedule attendance sessions

steps.title: Session
steps.help: Attendance belongs to a class session, not an editable daily register.

steps.title: Time and teacher
steps.help: Use the branch time zone. The teacher needs a dated eligible assignment.

steps.title: Review schedule
steps.help: Check calendar, offering/date overlap and teacher/date clashes.

fields.name: clash
fields.label: I have reviewed the conflict check.

workflows.outcome: The session appears in the assigned teacher’s teaching day.
workflows.rule: Reject overlapping scheduled sessions for the same primary teacher; roster freezes only when the session opens.
workflows.edge: Calendar conflict or teacher change explains the exact blocked interval.
workflows.data: Attendance owns AttendanceSession; Academics supplies Offering, Assignment and pinned CalendarRevision. Index both overlap query shapes.

workflows.title: Monitor and inspect attendance

steps.title: Choose the scope
steps.help: Completeness and attendance rate are separate metrics.

steps.title: Open a register
steps.help: Read its roster, submission state and revision history.

workflows.outcome: The exact session and its submission evidence are shown.
workflows.rule: School admin is not granted attendance.mark by default; link to assigned teacher, never impersonate them.
workflows.edge: Cancelled and unsubmitted sessions are distinct from absent pupils; missing denominator displays unavailable.
workflows.data: Read scoped Session → frozen roster → records/revisions, with current authorization and data-as-of timestamp.

workflows.title: Correct submitted attendance

steps.title: Select the record
steps.help: Corrections preserve the original submission.

steps.title: Record evidence
steps.help: A meaningful reason is mandatory.

fields.name: correct
fields.label: I have reviewed the original and corrected status.

workflows.outcome: A new correction revision appears with actor, reason and time.
workflows.rule: Only submitted attendance is correctable; compare the expected revision in the same authorized transaction.
workflows.edge: Another editor’s correction shows a conflict and comparison; unknown result uses the same request receipt.
workflows.data: Attendance appends immutable record/correction revision, audit and outbox; reporting reads the effective revision without destroying the original.

workflows.title: Cancel or review a session change

steps.title: Session and reason
steps.help: Show current state before offering allowed cancellation.

steps.title: Review consequences
steps.help: Cancellation keeps history and affects completeness transparently.

fields.name: cancel
fields.label: I have reviewed the session state and report impact.

workflows.outcome: A supported cancellation records its reason and preserved history.
workflows.rule: Do not silently reschedule an open/submitted session; use the supported state transition contract.
workflows.edge: Changed session state may block cancellation; refresh the current record before retry.
workflows.data: Attendance session state transition under version/guard, with audit/outbox and reporting status change.

workflows.title: Review an absence explanation

steps.title: Parent request
steps.help: A family explanation is not an attendance correction.

steps.title: Review disposition
steps.help: A separate authorized correction is needed if attendance itself changes.

workflows.outcome: The family receives a permitted disposition; attendance changes only through correction.
workflows.rule: Recheck guardian relationship at request/read/delivery; do not expose restricted notes.
workflows.edge: Late submission, duplicate explanation and revoked guardian access have separate outcomes.
workflows.data: Guardian/request owner records case; Attendance correction facade optional; Communication delivers under current grants.

workflows.title: Review and export attendance

steps.title: Report scope
steps.help: Start with one authorized branch and an explicit period.

steps.title: Review export
steps.help: Show columns, row count, completeness and the data timestamp.

fields.name: export
fields.label: I have reviewed the scope and permitted columns.

workflows.outcome: A scoped report and bounded export match the underlying session records.
workflows.rule: Rate = (Present + Late) / (Present + Late + Absent); Excused excluded. Zero denominator is unavailable.
workflows.edge: Unsubmitted data remains missing; revoked access is rechecked at export generation/download.
workflows.data: Reporting joins scoped sessions, effective records, frozen roster and student identifiers; export reads only allowed columns.

workflows.title: Compare trends and assign follow-up

steps.title: Review the metric
steps.help: Compare compatible periods with definition, denominator and freshness.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.help: Create a purpose-limited action for an authorized colleague.

workflows.outcome: The concern has an owner, due date and source evidence.
workflows.rule: Structured follow-up is a proposed extension, not claimed Phase 2 implementation; no punitive automated scoring.
workflows.edge: Low sample sizes, partial data and changed permissions limit drilldowns.
workflows.data: Reporting read model; proposed FollowUpCase stores references and minimal notes, with separate module design before implementation.

workflows.title: Verify and link a parent or guardian

steps.title: Student & adult
steps.help: Select a student from the authorized branch and the independently verified adult.

fields.name: student
fields.label: Student
options: Branch student by exact authorized ID

steps.title: Verify & choose access
steps.help: Mailbox possession is not proof. Record school verification and dates; select at least one independent purpose.

fields.name: verified
fields.label: I have verified the relationship and checked restrictions.

steps.title: Review
steps.help: Review child, adult, purpose and dates before approval. Approval creates an inactive grant.

workflows.outcome: A verified child-specific relationship and inactive selected purpose grants are approved. Intended-account acceptance activates only those approved purposes.
workflows.rule: No mailbox-only or sibling-inherited authorization. Each child-purpose link has verified identity, scope and dates; a draft never grants access.
workflows.edge: Invalid dates, duplicates, disputed identity, lost authorization and unfinished drafts have explicit recovery. Contact, fee, pickup and consent permissions remain separate.
workflows.data: Guardians owns Guardian and dated StudentGuardianGrant; references organization Person/Student and optional global UserAccount binding.

workflows.title: Invite a verified guardian

steps.title: Choose approved connection
steps.help: Open the exact verified relationship; use its verified contact, never enter an arbitrary replacement recipient.

steps.title: Review recipient and send
steps.help: Trust policy selects email or the existing operator-assisted path. Review actual delivery state.

workflows.outcome: An invitation has a visible delivery and acceptance state. Only intended-account acceptance activates the exact child’s approved grant.
workflows.rule: Recheck identity, trust mode, current policy, grant dates, purpose, restrictions and expected versions at acceptance; never treat parents as staff.
workflows.edge: Failed delivery cannot be consumed. Explicit resend replaces the old invitation. Expired, replaced, revoked and wrong-account links fail without exposing child data.
workflows.data: Guardians relationship and Access account binding; invite issue/consume with single-use hash, audit and delivery status.

workflows.title: Change, restrict or revoke a guardian link

steps.title: Choose connection and change
steps.help: The scope and impact stay visible; other children remain unaffected.

steps.title: Confirm the intended effect
steps.help: Date changes require fresh acceptance. Portal removal does not determine legal guardianship. Ending the school record requires a verified decision reference.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Bounded reason or school decision reference

workflows.outcome: The exact child grant or school relationship changes with history preserved; old invitations and protected views recheck current access.
workflows.rule: Keep portal revocation, relationship end and purpose changes separate. Preserve sibling and other-institution grants and source attendance.
workflows.edge: If a record is disputed, escalate privately and avoid notifying an unsafe recipient automatically.
workflows.data: Guardians grant revision/revocation, binding read and cancellation/suppression contracts for queued delivery.

workflows.title: Compose and send a school message

steps.title: Message
steps.help: Write a clear text notice. Acknowledgement is deliberate receipt, not consent.

steps.title: Recipients
steps.help: Resolve accounts from live approved purpose grants or staff membership; attendance alone is insufficient.

steps.title: Review
steps.help: Teacher submits for approval; an authorized school publisher confirms current draft and audience.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.label: I reviewed the message, audience, timing and acknowledgement.

workflows.outcome: A draft is approved, published or scheduled with a stable notice identity and exact immutable version. Recipients read and explicitly acknowledge through their own workspace.
workflows.rule: Explicit school-notice purpose and current scope control the audience. Teacher role has no blanket send authority. Read, provider acceptance and acknowledgement remain separate.
workflows.edge: Changed audience/draft requires renewed review. Lost publication response uses the existing receipt. Scheduled delivery rechecks the approved manifest without silently adding accounts.
workflows.data: Communication Notice/Draft/Version/Recipient/Binding, transaction receipt and initial outbox; Guardians/Access/Students resolve current account/purpose/enrollment.

workflows.title: Resolve failed delivery or missing acknowledgement

steps.title: Choose the notice or recipient
steps.help: Inspect distinct publication, notification, reading and acknowledgement evidence.

steps.title: Review the effect
steps.help: Only the exact eligible recipient/version can be changed.

fields.name: reference
fields.label: Safe reason or verification reference (when required)

workflows.outcome: A permitted delivery attempt, reminder, version, withdrawal or verified offline response is recorded while previous evidence remains intact.
workflows.rule: Never infer acknowledgement, silently overwrite a published notice or blindly retry Unknown. Current recipient grants and independent offline-response authority are checked.
workflows.edge: Withdrawal/revocation/version change blocks stale reads and acknowledgements; already-sent email cannot be recalled. Correction retains the same NoticeId and asks for current-version acknowledgement.
workflows.data: Immutable NoticeVersion, append-only DeliveryAttempt and exact-version Acknowledgement with recipient and actual actor/method; scoped current grant queries and safe receipts.

workflows.title: Review a family request

steps.title: Open request
steps.help: Limit each request to the relevant student and authorized office team.

steps.title: Respond
steps.help: An approved request invokes the owning module’s use case.

workflows.outcome: The family sees the decision and any next step.
workflows.rule: Do not let a general message edit attendance, identity or financial records directly.
workflows.edge: Revoked child relationship blocks further disclosure; keep an internal audit of the decision.
workflows.data: Request owner records decision; Students/Documents/People execute permitted changes via explicit contracts.

workflows.title: Capture inquiry and start an application

steps.title: Applicant
steps.help: An applicant is distinct from an enrolled student.

steps.title: Cycle and checklist
steps.help: Choose the relevant intake and required evidence.

fields.name: notice
fields.label: The approved collection notice has been provided.

workflows.outcome: An application has a reference, checklist and next action.
workflows.rule: Admission must work without Fees; collect only information needed for the current stage.
workflows.edge: Duplicate candidate suggests deliberate review; do not auto-merge applicants or existing pupils.
workflows.data: Admissions owns Applicant, Application, Cycle and checklist; no Student row until accepted conversion.

workflows.title: Review application and make a decision

steps.title: Review evidence
steps.help: Review only the documents within your assigned role.

steps.title: Decision
steps.help: Separate reviewer recommendation from authorized decision.

workflows.outcome: The decision revision and next action are recorded.
workflows.rule: Seat reservation and offer expiry must be atomic; subjective notes remain restricted.
workflows.edge: Last-seat conflicts and expired decision authority require refreshed capacity and delegation.
workflows.data: Admissions decision revision, capacity/offer reservation and audit; document download reauthorizes.

workflows.title: Accept an offer and enroll once

steps.title: Accepted offer
steps.help: Conversion follows verified acceptance and required evidence.

steps.title: Student handoff
steps.help: Preview the new student, placement and guardian verification work.

fields.name: convert
fields.label: I have reviewed identity and enrollment details.

workflows.outcome: One student conversion receipt links the application to enrollment.
workflows.rule: A repeated request returns the same conversion; do not create duplicate students or automatic guardian grants.
workflows.edge: Invalid capacity, changed acceptance or incomplete identity evidence pauses conversion safely.
workflows.data: Admissions conversion intent and Students owner transaction produce durable linkage; optional Finance/Documents handoffs are explicit.

workflows.title: Build and publish a timetable

steps.title: Draft schedule
steps.help: Keep draft separate from the published timetable.

steps.title: Resolve conflicts
steps.help: Validate teacher, room and calendar conflicts.

steps.title: Publish revision
steps.help: Preview generated session changes before confirmation.

fields.name: publish
fields.label: I have reviewed the published revision and future session impact.

workflows.outcome: A published timetable version drives idempotent future session generation.
workflows.rule: Existing open/submitted attendance stays pinned; recurring plan is not the Phase 1 manual-session contract.
workflows.edge: Clash races and repeated generation cannot produce double sessions.
workflows.data: Academics owns TimetableVersion/slots, room and teacher constraints; Attendance consumes versioned generation commands.

workflows.title: Arrange cover or a timetable exception

steps.title: Affected session
steps.help: Choose a dated exception, not a permanent identity reassignment.

steps.title: Review access and notice
steps.help: The cover teacher receives only the required dated scope.

fields.name: cover
fields.label: Eligibility and clashes have been reviewed.

workflows.outcome: The supported substitution is visible to the affected staff.
workflows.rule: Never use shared logins; do not replace historical assignment attribution.
workflows.edge: Unavailable cover or an already opened session invokes the defined review path.
workflows.data: Academics owns Substitution with effective period; Attendance assignment-resolution contract and Communication notification request.

workflows.title: Review learning readiness and follow-up

steps.title: Choose the class
steps.help: Show completion and workload within explicit school authority.

steps.title: Coordinate support
steps.help: Teachers remain authors of lesson content and feedback.

workflows.outcome: An authorized follow-up points to the owning learning record.
workflows.rule: Do not reveal draft feedback to guardians or auto-score missing work as zero.
workflows.edge: Revoked enrollment or assignment restricts content; attachments remain private and scanned.
workflows.data: Learning read projection of Assignment/SubmissionRevision/Feedback; follow-up command does not publish teacher drafts.

workflows.title: Collect and review a document

steps.title: Request context
steps.help: A document needs a purpose, owner and permitted audience.

steps.title: Upload and review
steps.help: Uploads stay unavailable until their safety checks complete.

workflows.outcome: The document version and review state are visible to authorized users.
workflows.rule: No public object URLs; scan failure never becomes a successful upload; expiry and retention follow approved policy.
workflows.edge: Interrupted upload resumes or retries safely; expired access links reauthorize.
workflows.data: Documents owns FileAsset, ScanResult, DocumentVersion and grant. Owning module references the immutable approved version.

workflows.title: Issue a certificate or publish a form

steps.title: Template and audience
steps.help: Use a versioned approved template.

steps.title: Review generated content
steps.help: Validate source fields and intended recipient.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed the exact document preview.

workflows.outcome: An issued revision has a reference and controlled download.
workflows.rule: Do not overwrite issued documents; corrections issue a new linked version.
workflows.edge: Unavailable source data and revoked recipient grants prevent issue/download.
workflows.data: DocumentTemplateVersion → immutable issue snapshot or FormSchemaVersion/FormResponse, with signed-download authorization.

workflows.title: Coordinate assessment setup and marks readiness

steps.title: Assessment plan
steps.help: Choose versioned grading and rounding rules.

steps.title: Readiness
steps.help: Review missing marks, absent and exempt states independently.

workflows.outcome: The assessment moves only when its defined prerequisites are met.
workflows.rule: School coordination does not imply permission to edit teachers’ marks.
workflows.edge: Not-entered, absent and exempt are separate; no automatic numeric zero.
workflows.data: Assessment scheme/version and read model of MarkRevision/Moderation; owner use cases enforce role-specific actions.

workflows.title: Approve, publish or correct results

steps.title: Review approved revision
steps.help: Publication pins exact mark and approval revisions.

steps.title: Audience and confirmation
steps.help: Only entitled, authorized family panels can receive the release.

fields.name: publish
fields.label: The approved content and audience have been reviewed.

workflows.outcome: Published results or a linked correction are available with a timestamp.
workflows.rule: Draft edits never leak; approval and publication cannot race past changed marks.
workflows.edge: Changed revision requires reapproval; partial delivery does not unpublish the valid result.
workflows.data: ResultPublicationManifest references approved immutable MarkRevisions; Communication queues minimal notices.

workflows.title: Configure fees and concessions

steps.title: Plan scope
steps.help: Finance is independent of Attendance.

steps.title: Concession review
steps.help: Approval authority is separate from requesting a concession.

workflows.outcome: An approved plan revision can be used to generate invoice snapshots.
workflows.rule: General school administrators have coordination access only unless explicitly granted finance authority.
workflows.edge: In-use fee plans version forward; negative/invalid money and unsupported currency are rejected.
workflows.data: Finance owns FeePlanVersion and Concession decision. Store money in exact minor units with currency; no floats.

workflows.title: Generate invoices and collect payment

steps.title: Invoice preview
steps.help: Review payer, lines, currency and due date.

steps.title: Collection
steps.help: Show actual payment evidence and allocation.

workflows.outcome: Posted invoice, verified payment and receipt retain separate states.
workflows.rule: A browser success return is not proof of payment; callbacks authenticate and deduplicate.
workflows.edge: Unknown outcomes are reconciled before retrying; partial payment leaves an explicit balance.
workflows.data: Finance Invoice/Line snapshots, Payment, Allocation and Receipt, with unique provider/reference constraints and audit.

workflows.title: Resolve reconciliation, adjustment or refund

steps.title: Exception
steps.help: Open the exact ledger and provider evidence.

steps.title: Review approval
steps.help: Posted history is immutable; refunds reserve available value.

workflows.outcome: An authorized adjustment or reconciled outcome appends to the ledger.
workflows.rule: Do not edit posted amounts or double-refund an uncertain provider request.
workflows.edge: Timeout, duplicate callback, insufficient refundable balance and rejected approval have explicit outcomes.
workflows.data: Finance CreditNote, RefundReservation, Settlement and append-only ledger entries; idempotent provider seam.

workflows.title: Prepare routes and allocate students

steps.title: Route and capacity
steps.help: Use eligible vehicles and drivers.

steps.title: Student allocation
steps.help: Confirm approved stop and handoff arrangements.

workflows.outcome: A dated allocation contributes to the next trip manifest.
workflows.rule: Transport consent, pickup authority and guardian portal grant are separate.
workflows.edge: Full vehicle, expired qualification or unavailable stop blocks the allocation.
workflows.data: Transport RouteVersion, Stop, Vehicle/DriverQualification, Allocation and trip manifest snapshot.

workflows.title: Resolve a trip or handoff exception

steps.title: Trip event
steps.help: Protect live child location and identity.

steps.title: Safe resolution
steps.help: Follow the school’s approved emergency protocol.

workflows.outcome: An accountable trip exception is recorded and escalated where needed.
workflows.rule: Never confirm an unverified handoff; minimize live location exposure.
workflows.edge: Disconnected device or uncertain event preserves pending status and uses the approved human fallback.
workflows.data: Trip and BoardingEvent append; route/vehicle changes reviewed; Communication uses minimal authorized notices.

workflows.title: Review leave and staffing coverage

steps.title: Leave request
steps.help: Show dates and staffing impact; keep sensitive attachments restricted.

steps.title: Coverage
steps.help: Coordinate cover through Timetable; no attendance auto-edit.

workflows.outcome: The leave balance and coverage decisions are recorded separately.
workflows.rule: Pupil attendance and staff attendance are different domains; serialize concurrent leave debits.
workflows.edge: Insufficient balance or changed approver authority blocks approval.
workflows.data: People operations owns LeaveRequest/BalanceLedger; Academics owns cover; Employee identity read via People contract.

workflows.title: Review payroll inputs and hand off

steps.title: Pay period
steps.help: Only authorized payroll staff see salary figures.

steps.title: Approval evidence
steps.help: Use jurisdiction-specific versioned rules.

workflows.outcome: Authorized payroll review proceeds with immutable approved run history.
workflows.rule: A School Administrator role grants no salary access; no payroll formula is assumed in this design.
workflows.edge: Rule change, missing input or revoked approval stops the run; corrections create a new linked revision.
workflows.data: Restricted PayrollRun, rule version and input references; immutable approval/export evidence. Separate regulatory design required.

workflows.title: Catalog and circulate library items

steps.title: Identify the copy
steps.help: Barcode identifies a physical copy, not only the title.

steps.title: Circulation
steps.help: Check eligibility and active hold policy.

workflows.outcome: The loan or reservation is recorded with a clear due date.
workflows.rule: Only one active loan per physical copy; fines are optional Finance integration.
workflows.edge: Already loaned, hold queue conflict, lost item and duplicate scan have explicit outcomes.
workflows.data: CatalogItem, PhysicalCopy, Loan, Reservation and versioned policy. Lock copy/hold state in circulation transaction.

workflows.title: Resolve overdue, lost or inventory discrepancies

steps.title: Exception
steps.help: Review loan and item history.

steps.title: Disposition
steps.help: Use a reasoned adjustment rather than deleting history.

workflows.outcome: The item and borrower record show the reasoned outcome.
workflows.rule: Loss/recovery preserves circulation history; no automatic guardian billing without the Finance contract.
workflows.edge: Concurrent return and loss adjustment reconcile under the copy guard.
workflows.data: PhysicalCopy state, Loan closure/revision, inventory evidence and optional FineCharge event.

workflows.title: Receive, issue or return stock and assets

steps.title: Item and movement
steps.help: Separate quantity stock from individually tracked assets.

steps.title: Custody evidence
steps.help: Track who received it and why.

workflows.outcome: An append-only movement and current custody state are available.
workflows.rule: No negative stock unless explicitly approved by a versioned policy; cross-branch transfer requires both scopes.
workflows.edge: Concurrent issue or missing custody acknowledgement leaves a reviewable exception.
workflows.data: Inventory StockMovement ledger and Asset/CustodyAssignment; owner transaction controls available stock.

workflows.title: Book a facility or request maintenance

steps.title: Facility
steps.help: Choose an available resource and date.

steps.title: Purpose
steps.help: A maintenance closure blocks conflicting use.

workflows.outcome: A conflict-free booking or owned maintenance order is recorded.
workflows.rule: Enforce overlapping reservation constraints and clear unavailable periods.
workflows.edge: Concurrent booking or changed maintenance status shows alternatives instead of double-booking.
workflows.data: FacilityBooking range constraint and MaintenanceOrder; published timetable room use checked through Academics contract.

workflows.title: Refer a health or safeguarding concern
workflows.capability: restricted referral.create; case read requires explicit specialist grant

steps.title: Minimal referral
steps.help: Avoid sensitive details in shared dashboards and notifications.

fields.name: urgency
fields.label: Urgency
options: Urgent: follow approved school emergency protocol

steps.title: Restricted handoff
steps.help: This review prototype stores no clinical narrative.

workflows.outcome: An authorized specialist receives a minimal referral; general admins see only permitted handoff status.
workflows.rule: No diagnosis or clinical advice in the general school workspace; emergency action follows the approved local protocol.
workflows.edge: If the recipient lacks authority, route privately to the approved escalation contact; never broadcast.
workflows.data: Restricted referral and purpose grant; HealthProfile/Visit/Incident remain specialist-owned and separately access controlled.

workflows.title: Review emergency access and restricted case handling

steps.title: Exceptional access
steps.help: Available only to explicitly authorized emergency roles.

steps.title: Accountable review
steps.help: Access is time bounded and independently reviewed.

fields.name: ack
fields.label: The approved emergency access procedure applies.

workflows.outcome: Authorized emergency access has an expiry, audit and independent review.
workflows.rule: No blanket administrator access; this workflow requires a separate sensitive-data design and deployment approval.
workflows.edge: Denied or expired emergency authority must not reveal case contents.
workflows.data: RestrictedNoteGrant/break-glass event and specialist record access audit; no details in general activity.

workflows.title: Review connection status and reconcile a sync

steps.title: Connection
steps.help: Credentials remain in a secure store and never in the screen or audit.

steps.title: Review effects
steps.help: Map source IDs and preview changes before committing.

fields.name: scope
fields.label: The target branch and permitted changes are correct.

workflows.outcome: A scoped synchronization run has reconciled per-record outcomes.
workflows.rule: No unreviewed source overwrites; authenticated webhooks deduplicate and reauthorize.
workflows.edge: Unknown provider outcome, duplicate webhook and mapping conflict stay visible.
workflows.data: IntegrationCredentialRef, SyncRun, WebhookReceipt and owner module commands. No direct writes to another module’s tables.

workflows.title: Review activity, privacy or support access
workflows.capability: school.audit.read; privacy/support actions need separate authority

steps.title: Find activity
steps.help: Show only safe events in this branch.

steps.title: Inspect evidence
steps.help: Use a request reference for support; do not expose credentials or raw imported data.

workflows.outcome: A safe branch-scoped event is available for review.
workflows.rule: The administrator cannot delete audit history, grant operator impersonation or run an unrestricted data export.
workflows.edge: Restricted events show permitted metadata only; unsupported privacy requests route to the designated authority.
workflows.data: Append-only audit read model scoped by branch and capability; safe diff and request IDs only.

workflows.title: Review an AI-assisted explanation or draft

steps.title: Choose an allowed task
steps.help: The assistant retrieves only evidence already permitted to you.

steps.title: Check sources
steps.help: The answer must carry source references and an as-of time.

fields.name: sources
fields.label: I have checked the cited evidence and any uncertainty.

steps.title: Use a reviewed draft
steps.help: Business changes still use normal authorized forms.

workflows.outcome: A reviewed draft or explanation can support a human decision.
workflows.rule: No unrestricted SQL, autonomous record changes or sensitive health/disciplinary inference.
workflows.edge: Missing evidence, provider outage and suspicious retrieved instructions trigger abstention or a safe fallback.
workflows.data: AssistantSession, scoped EvidenceReference and ActionProposal; deterministic calculations from owner read contracts.

communication_integration.first_slice: Text notices, approval, scheduling, versioned acknowledgement and delivery follow-up
